UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the application. It stores user-specific information and their assigned roles.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login.

displayName.description: A user-friendly name for display purposes.

isAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the user has administrative privileges.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID (`userId`) MUST be the user's Firebase Authentication UID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.
